notes: Ranges are engineering priors, not certificates for the user's actual door.
Wood products are moisture-, density-, resin-, and grain-dependent; dielectric ranges are deliberately broad.
All non-metal door-core entries are treated as mu_r approximately 1 in the magnetic near-field solver.

solid_timber.status: wide prior; moisture and grain dominate

plywood.status: wide prior; veneer, adhesive, and moisture dependent

MDF.status: wide prior; density, resin, and moisture dependent

particleboard.status: wide prior; density, resin, and moisture dependent

fire_rated_composite.status: generic non-metal core only; hidden steel is modeled separately

mild_steel.status: RF effective permeability is alloy, field, and geometry dependent

stainless_steel.status: covers austenitic material plus work-hardening/grade uncertainty

low.status: representative flexible NFC sheet; TDK IFL04 anchor is 45/1.3 at 13.56 MHz

medium.status: interpolated engineering class; select an actual part before release

high.status: representative high-permeability NFC sheet; TDK IBF15 anchor is 150/5 at 13.56 MHz
